name: redeemid/product
title: Shopify Product
description: One Shopify product with its live price, an options picker, a quantity field, Add to cart and a buy button that goes straight to Shopify checkout. Rendered on the server, works without JavaScript and without Shopify's own plugin.

attributes.label: Shopify product
attributes.help: Search your Shopify products by title. Leave empty on RedeemID's product page template to show the product in the URL.

attributes.label: Heading level
attributes.help: One level below the heading the block sits under, so screen reader users can follow the page outline. On its own product page the title is always the page's H1.

attributes.label: Add to cart label
attributes.help: Shown when RedeemID's cart is on (it is off while Shopify's own plugin runs the cart).

attributes.label: Show buy-now button next to Add to cart
